title: Registration — the clock is ticking
text: The rules give a short time to register your place of stay after arrival: 7 working days for most visitors; for people who come to work, 15 days for citizens of Tajikistan and Uzbekistan and 30 days for those of Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan and Armenia (Belarus: 90). As reported in 2024; the rules change often and the game simplifies how the days are counted. Your host, a landlord or a hostel has to submit the notice through the MFC, post office or Gosuslugi.

choices.t: Ask your landlord to submit the notice (honest)
choices.then: The landlord refuses: "I don't do paperwork." You lose a day and some nerves.
The fixer produces a valid notice. Expensive but real.

title: Registration is running out
text: Your registration has less than 20 days. Renewal needs the host's consent, the migration card and the receipt.

choices.then: Number 142 in the queue, but you leave with a fresh notice.

choices.t: Pay a "helper" to jump the queue
choices.then: Done in 20 minutes for ₽3,000. The helper vanishes into the crowd.

title: Medical exam for migrants
text: Before a patent you need a medical certificate: infectious diseases, drug test, fingerprinting, Russian language test. Clinics near Sakharovo are crowded.

choices.then: Eight stamps, three stations, one ID. You walk out with the certificate.
No queue, same certificate, double price.

title: Patent payment
text: A work patent is paid for in monthly advance payments of income tax. In Moscow it was ₽8,900 a month in 2025 and rose to about ₽10,000 from 1 January 2026 (other regions differ). Pay on time and keep the receipts. After you receive the patent you must notify the Interior Ministry within two months.

choices.then: You tell yourself you will pay on Friday.

title: You need a health insurance policy for the patent
text: To get a work patent a labour migrant must hold a voluntary health insurance policy (DMS) that covers at least ₽100,000 and lasts as long as the patent. The price in the game is an approximation: about ₽5,000 for three months. You can also buy it in Online services → Buy health insurance.

choices.then: An insurer prints a policy with your name and a hotline number. Now the patent can be bought.
You open three insurance sites and close them again.

title: Notify the Interior Ministry about your patent
text: After getting a patent you must send a notification to the Interior Ministry within two months. A friend warns: "If you forget, the patent can be suspended for a year."

choices.t: File the notification at the MFC today
choices.then: A form, a stamp and a receipt. One less thing to worry about.

title: Your patent has been suspended
text: A clerk reads the screen: "You did not send the notification within two months. The patent is suspended for a year." Everything you do for work now counts as illegal.

choices.t: Accept it and look for another way
choices.then: You read the rules three times. A lawyer tells you: next time, mark the date in your phone.

title: Check the register of controlled persons
text: Foreigners with unresolved violations can be placed on a register of "controlled persons" with restrictions. A friend recommends checking your status on the official website.

choices.then: Your name is not on the list. You exhale.

title: Unpaid fines and the bailiffs' database
text: Before certain applications, unpaid fines must be cleared. You can search the bailiffs' (FSSP) database by name and date of birth.

choices.then: The fine would have grown with time.

title: Student visa extension
text: The university international office stamps the extension request. The migration service needs your attendance record.

choices.then: Approved. Visa extended for a year.
They sigh, check the list and say you are fine.

title: Working as a student?
text: Students can work only with specific permissions. A dean's letter plus a contract with the employer opens the door.

title: Russian language, history and law exam
text: The exam has three modules: Russian language, history of Russia, and the basics of legislation. The residence-permit version takes about two and a quarter hours and costs about ₽5,300 at a university testing centre (prices differ by centre; the shorter patent version is about ₽4,900). Fail one module and you can retake just that one for half price; fail two or more and you retake everything at full price. Beware of anyone selling a "guaranteed result".

choices.t: Prepare properly and take the exam (₽5,300)
choices.then: You fail two or more modules. You must retake all three modules at full price.
The certificate is checked in the official registry. It is not there. Serious trouble.

title: Temporary residence permit (RVP)
text: You have the language certificate and a ground for RVP (quota place, marriage to a citizen, or a Russian child). Income proof, clean record, medical certificate, fingerprints. The clerk says: "Decision within 6 months".

choices.then: Approved. The stamp goes into your passport; you no longer need a patent.

title: Permanent residence permit (VNZh)
text: After at least a year on RVP you can apply for the residence permit (VNZh): a card valid for five years, renewable, with the right to live and work without a patent. You must show regular income, tax payments and a clean record. (In real life the waiting times are years; the game shortens them to months.)

choices.then: Approved. The VNZh card arrives: green, five years, enormous relief.

title: Russian citizenship
text: Normally citizenship takes about five years of residence on a residence permit, or three if you are married to a citizen. You apply with documents, an interview and an oath, and then you receive the passport. (The game shortens the waiting to a few months.)

choices.then: You cannot pay the ₽50,000 state duty yet.

title: RVP quota application
text: Each region has a yearly quota for temporary residence permits. You must apply for a quota place, which may take months. The queue at the Migration Department (GUVM) starts at 5 a.m.

choices.then: Quota for your region has run out. Come back next year.
Marriage to a Russian citizen or having a Russian child opens RVP without the quota.

title: A "helper" at the MFC
text: A man in a leather jacket approaches you: "Documents, patent, registration — fast, ₽7,000, no queue."

choices.then: He moves to the next person.
Surprisingly works — but you know it is a risk.

choices.t: Report him to the MFC guard
choices.then: The guard nods and takes a note. Maybe it helps.

title: Gosuslugi is down
text: The "State Services" website shows an error page. The queue at the MFC in person is 90 minutes.

choices.then: You read half a novel on your phone.

title: Letter from the military enlistment office
text: An envelope arrives: "Please appear at the voenkomat." Rumours ripple through the family chat.

choices.then: Medical commission, questionnaires, a long afternoon. You walk out with a new status.
Ignoring does not remove the file — and fines add up.

title: Your home passport is expiring
text: The embassy of your country in Moscow has a long queue and strict rules. A valid national passport is needed for registration, patent and every later step.

choices.t: Renew at the embassy (₽8,000 with fees)
choices.then: New passport in six weeks. Documents stay in order.
The expiry date does not move.

title: Register with your consulate
text: Your country's consulate asks citizens abroad to register. It helps if you lose documents or need an emergency passport.

choices.then: A small card goes into your wallet. It feels reassuring.
You skip it. Famous last words.

title: Check your entry ban status
text: A friend says a violation can put you on a list that bans entry for years. You can check your status through official channels.

choices.t: Check status at the migration service

title: Lost passport
text: Your wallet and passport are gone. Without it you cannot prove status, register, or work.

choices.t: Report to police and go to the embassy
choices.then: Report, embassy form, new passport in three weeks. The delay costs you.

title: Employer must notify authorities
text: Your employer must notify the migration service about hiring you. A careless employer forgets; a fair one files in three days.

choices.then: HR says "we will get to it" and does not.

title: RVP outside quota (marriage)
text: Marriage to a Russian citizen gives you the right to apply for temporary residence without the quota. The ZAGS certificate, your partner's passport and a joint photo list are needed.

choices.then: Accepted for review. The ground for RVP is confirmed.

title: RVP outside quota (Russian child)
text: Having a child who is a Russian citizen gives you a ground for RVP without the quota.

choices.then: The migration office accepts the application as a family ground.

title: You no longer need a patent
text: The patent offices send you a farewell leaflet. RVP lets you work without it. One small paper gone.

choices.then: It tastes better than any patent receipt.

title: Residence notification
text: Residents on RVP must notify the migration service about their address and job every year.

choices.then: Done in one visit. A small win.

title: Language and history refresh
text: The citizenship interview includes questions about Russian history, law and daily life. A colleague offers to quiz you.

choices.then: You learn why Pushkin is in every textbook.

title: Newborn paperwork
text: Birth certificate at ZAGS, child registration, SNILS and a polyclinic attachment.

choices.t: Do it all in one trip
choices.then: One document is missing; second visit.

title: Unpaid wages, small claims
text: Your employer owes you a month of wages. A friend says: "Go to the court, it is free for small claims."

choices.t: File a statement with the labour inspectorate
choices.then: An officer calls the employer. The money arrives the next day.

title: Power of attorney
text: You need someone at home to act on your behalf in a property matter. A notary can draw up a power of attorney.

choices.then: The matter drags on, and your relatives keep asking.

title: A debt notice
text: A letter from the bailiffs (FSSP) arrives with your name and a sum you do not recognise.

choices.t: Check it on the official website and call
choices.then: It is a mistake: a different person with the same name.
Three weeks later your card is blocked.

title: Read the employment contract
text: Your employer hands you a long contract and says "just sign here, everyone does".

choices.t: Read it and ask about unclear points
choices.then: You catch a clause about unpaid overtime and negotiate it out.

title: A court summons
text: A white envelope: "You are called as a witness in a case." Your hands are cold.

choices.t: Go and tell what you saw
choices.then: The judge is brisk, the lawyer polite. You are done in two hours.
A second letter arrives, less friendly, with a fine.

title: Recognition of a diploma
text: Your diploma from home must be recognised in Russia before you can work in your profession.

choices.then: Months later: "Recognised." You are legal in your field.

title: Tax deduction for studies
text: You can claim back part of what you paid for education through the tax service portal.

choices.t: File the form on the portal
choices.then: A month later ₽8,000 arrives on your card.

title: Marriage name change
text: After the wedding you decide to change your surname in all documents.

choices.t: Do the whole circuit: passport, bank, SNILS, driving licence
choices.then: Three weeks of queues. Then everything is aligned.

title: Fine: a speed camera
text: A notification in the Gosuslugi app: your car was recorded doing 71 km/h in a 60 zone. The amount is ₽500. Paying within 20 days gets you a discount (a simplified rule in the game); ignoring it makes it grow.

choices.t: Pay it now with the early discount
choices.then: You pay ₽250 in the app at once. Receipt saved.

choices.t: Deal with it later (use Online services → Pay fines)
choices.then: You leave it in the app. The clock ticks.
You close the app. The amount stays in the system.

title: A reminder about your unpaid fines
text: A message from the bailiffs' service: "You have unpaid fines. After 60 days the amount doubles and enforcement begins."

choices.t: Open Online services and pay them
choices.then: You switch to the payment screen straight away.

title: Bailiffs and a blocked card
text: The bailiffs have taken the money for the fines (now doubled, with a minimum of ₽1,000) from your card, plus a fee. A note says: "Debt closed. Please read your notifications." In real life a court can also choose up to 15 days of arrest or up to 50 hours of compulsory labour instead; the game uses the doubled fine.

choices.then: It is an expensive lesson in paying on time.
